source_snapshot.note: both NOAA 269-column original month rows browser-read and preserved, full publisher-file bytes and official original hash not downloaded; no hourly/site/causal confirmation
source_snapshot.station_distinction: Bangor and Bar Harbor are distinct historical instruments/station rows but share NOAA GHCN archive/custodian; not independent proof of any extraordinary weather mechanism
source_snapshot.observation_time_status: historical station precipitation accumulation cutoff unverified, so a July 6 zero cannot settle rain onset near 22:00 on July 6

algorithm.retraction: Any claim depending on a withdrawn source is marked reopened (not false). A claim with status unpaid remains unpaid. Unrelated independently grounded claims retain their status.
algorithm.prohibition: No edge automatically promotes author assertions or observed precipitation into device causality; model statuses are bibliographic, not ontology truth. An uploader's third-person promotional biography cannot certify Navy employment, historical device construction, or Flanagan-Gentry-Croft technical handoff.
algorithm.clock_bucket_sensitivity: If station local July 6 22h is stipulated and cutoffs are assumed to end local right-closed 24h windows, cutoff before 22h labels hypothetical rain as July 7 and cutoff at/after 22h labels July 6; without observed station clock and at-site hour neither bucket identifies Reich event.
algorithm.isd_time_nonpromotion: Original ISD 1953 station-year file existence does not imply 1953-07-06 data coverage, AA1 rainfall report, UTC-to-Maine-local converter, independent observer root, or any intervention effect. Invalid or absent payload remains unpaid, not false.
algorithm.replay_correction: Earlier parser incorrectly equated first-four ISD variable characters with complete record length, self-tests then used equally defective synthetic fixture; all prior claimed source format playback requires corrected 105+variable invariant. Executed corrected fixtures do not pay original 1953 bytes or event-hour chronology.
